name: binge-senpai
description: Your anime and manga library in ChatGPT: see what's next, log what you've watched, and get picks ranked from your own taste.

interface.longDescription:
Binge Senpai is an anime and manga tracker. Connect it and ChatGPT can work with your own library: what you're watching, what you've finished and how you rated it.

What you can do:
- Ask what's next: new episodes out in the shows you're watching, what to continue, and what airs today in your time zone.
- Log many titles at once: "I've seen Steins;Gate, Odd Taxi and 86" adds them in one go. It never changes a title you already have, and asks which one you mean when a name fits more than one show.
- Keep your list current: update progress, status, score and dates, mark a title Not for me, or remove one.
- Get recommendations ranked from your own library, with your Match % for any title and a short reason ("Because you watched Steins;Gate").
- Search the catalog by name or by theme, and look up any title: episodes, next episode, streaming services, and which season of its series it is.

Before you allow it, the sign-in screen lists what ChatGPT asks to do: see your library and change it. You can disconnect any time in Binge Senpai under Settings → Connected assistants. Adult-rated (R+ and Rx) titles are excluded. You need a Binge Senpai account, which you can create while connecting.
capabilities: See new episodes and what to continue in what you're watching
Log many anime or manga titles at once
Update progress, status, score and dates
Recommendations ranked from your own library, with Match %
Search the anime and manga catalog by name or theme
defaultPrompt: What should I watch next from what I'm watching?
I've watched Steins;Gate, Odd Taxi and 86. Log them as seen.
Recommend something like Mushishi I haven't seen.

positive.description: What's next in what the person is watching
positive.prompt: What should I watch next from what I'm watching?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists what the test account has to watch: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End to continue at episode 19, Dan Da Dan at episode 7, the seasonal show it follows with its newest aired episode unwatched, and planned titles such as Vinland Saga. Nothing outside the account's library is presented as in progress.

positive.description: Log several watched titles at once without changing one already in the library
positive.prompt: I've watched Steins;Gate, Odd Taxi and 86. Log them as seen.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds Odd Taxi and 86 Eighty-Six as completed. Steins;Gate is already in the library (completed, scored 9) and is reported as already there, unchanged.

positive.description: Recommendations like a named title, ranked from the person's library
positive.prompt: Recommend something like Mushishi I haven't seen.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Mushi-Shi, then returns titles like it that aren't in the library or marked Not for me, each with the account's Match % and a short reason.

positive.description: Update progress on a title in the library
positive.prompt: I just finished episode 7 of Dandadan.
positive.expected_behavior: Dan Da Dan goes from 6 to 7 episodes watched and stays in progress; the reply confirms the change.

positive.description: Remove one title from the library
positive.prompt: Remove Your Name. from my library.
positive.expected_behavior: After the person confirms, Your Name. is removed from the library (it was planned) and the reply confirms what was removed. No other title changes.

negative.description: Adult content is out of scope: the connector never returns adult-rated (R+ and Rx) titles or adult genres, whatever the account's settings.
negative.expected_behavior: No adult titles are listed; the assistant says Binge Senpai doesn't provide them here.

negative.description: Another person's data: the connector reaches only the signed-in account's own library, and no tool takes another user.
negative.prompt: Show me my friend Kenji's anime list on Binge Senpai.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant explains it can only see the connected account's library and returns no one else's data.

negative.description: Purchases: Binge Senpai doesn't sell anything or handle payments.
negative.prompt: Buy me a Crunchyroll subscription so I can watch Frieren.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is bought. The assistant may say where Frieren streams (title details list streaming services) and leaves subscribing to the person.

review.commerce_description: Binge Senpai doesn't sell anything or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: see what's next in what you're watching, log titles in bulk, update progress and scores, get recommendations ranked from your own library, and search the anime and manga catalog.
